changelog:
- Added the Manual Zoom feature under General > Manual Zoom. You can now zoom in at any time. Includes various settings, such as Focus FX and separate key bindings for gamepad and keyboard/mouse.
- Added an option to select the key used to toggle ADS under Weapons > ADS. You can now choose which key toggles ADS.
- Added an option to change the key binding used to open the menu with a gamepad under General > Menu.
- Added UltimateFP_RegisterCinematicCondition to the API, allowing external mods to register custom conditions that can trigger Cinematic Mode. Registered conditions appear under General > Cinematic > External Conditions.
- Fixed some bugs
